author: ritzrani
body: Rachael in Irvine, its in an industrial complex by hummingbird coffee. Their beans and rice are vegetarian:)

author: nhaines
body: My partner and I used to eat there weekly when we worked nearby. Was always very solid and Rachael was super nice. Haven't gotten back in a long time, although it was on my list last year because I was doing work nearby (but mostly in the evenings or weekends when they were closed).
